snippet.title: Hopeless Sea OTK Expo trailer
snippet.description:
Our solo indie game Hopeless Sea is going to be covered by OTK Games Expo from 26th May. Here is it's latest trailer.
The 1.0 release is in June, and date will be announced soon on OTK Expo. Stay tuned folks!
